summary: Verified both reported sidebar bugs are FIXED. Mobile hamburger now opens overlay sidebar (previously disappeared silently). Tablet/desktop 'Home' navigation resolves to '/' instead of throwing 'Page not found'. Desktop collapse toggle works with animation.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking warning: 'useNativeDriver: true' is not supported on web (RCTAnimation missing) — sidebarAnim in _layout.tsx already uses useNativeDriver:false (good), but other components in the app still trigger the warning. Consider centralizing an animation helper.
Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on web — migrate to 'boxShadow' throughout components.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar layout at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx: mobile hamburger uses testID='sidebar-toggle', overlay testID='sidebar-overlay', nav items testID='sidebar-nav-{index|market|news|profile}', desktop collapse testID='sidebar-collapse-toggle'. Login flow: landing page → click 'I have an account' → 2 inputs (email/password) → submit button. After login, user lands on /learn. Mobile bp = width<768. Verified viewports: 390x844 mobile, 1024x768 tablet, 1920x1080 desktop.
rca of the issue: BUG1 root cause: previous mobile overlay used StyleSheet.absoluteFill inside a flex-row container which didn't stretch and left overlay invisible. Fix: replaced with explicit position:absolute + top/left/right/bottom:0 + zIndex 998/999 and moved rendering to end of JSX. BUG2 root cause: router.push('/(tabs)/index') 404s in Expo Router since index routes map to '/'. Fix: handleNavigate maps 'index' to '/(tabs)/'. Both fixes verified live.
